title: Bible Challenge
seoDescription: Take a fun 80-question Bible challenge covering famous stories, people, places, parables, books, broad timelines, and careful clues.
pageTitle: Only 9% Can Pass This Bible Challenge
summary: A fun staged Bible quiz about famous stories, people, places, parables, books, timelines, and careful clues.

homepage.title: Can You Pass This Bible Challenge?
homepage.summary: From famous stories to parables, places, and careful clues, see how much of the Bible you remember.

footer.aboutText: This Bible Challenge is designed for entertainment and self-testing. It is not an official religious exam, theological assessment, church qualification, spiritual evaluation, or statement of belief. The quiz uses broad Bible knowledge questions and simplified summaries.

landing.quickStartText: Start with familiar stories, then test people, places, parables, and timeline clues.

stageGroups.title: Bible Warm Up
stageGroups.encouragement: Good start. The next round moves into famous stories.

questions.prompt: In the opening Bible story, what is created first?
questions.explanation: The opening story begins with light.

questions.prompt: Which person is most linked with leading the Israelites out of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Moses is the central person in the Exodus story.

questions.prompt: Which came first: Noah's ark or the birth of Jesus?
choices: They happen at the same time
The Bible does not mention either
questions.explanation: Noah's story appears much earlier in the Bible.

questions.prompt: Remember this pair for later: Bethlehem = Birthplace. Which word is paired with Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: The memory pair is Bethlehem = Birthplace.

questions.prompt: In the Noah story, what large object is Noah told to build?
questions.explanation: Noah is linked with building an ark.

questions.prompt: Which person is widely linked with being a shepherd and later a king?
questions.explanation: David is remembered as a shepherd who became king.

questions.prompt: Which belongs earlier in the Bible story: the Garden of Eden or Paul's journeys?
questions.explanation: The Garden of Eden appears near the beginning.

questions.prompt: Which item does not belong with Bible places?
questions.explanation: A telescope is an object, not a Bible place.

stageGroups.title: Famous Stories
stageGroups.encouragement: Nice work. Now the quiz checks people and places.

questions.prompt: Remember this pair for later: Jericho = Walls. Which word is paired with Jericho?
questions.explanation: The memory pair is Jericho = Walls.

questions.prompt: Which story is most linked with Jonah?
questions.explanation: Jonah is widely linked with the great fish story.

questions.prompt: Which story is most linked with Daniel?
questions.explanation: Daniel is widely linked with the lions' den story.

questions.prompt: Which person is strongly linked with a promise of a large family?
questions.explanation: Abraham is linked with a promise about his descendants.

questions.prompt: Which place is most linked with a river where Jesus was baptized?
questions.explanation: The Jordan River is linked with the baptism of Jesus.

questions.prompt: Which came first: Moses leading the Exodus or David becoming king?
questions.explanation: Moses appears earlier than David in the Bible story.

questions.prompt: A clue says a man built a large boat before a flood. Which answer is safest?
choices: The clue proves the boat was in Jerusalem
questions.explanation: The safe conclusion is the person is Noah; the clue does not add a city.

questions.prompt: Which story tells of a stranger helping a hurt traveler?
questions.explanation: The Good Samaritan is the story of a stranger helping a traveler.

stageGroups.title: People And Places
stageGroups.encouragement: Strong pace. The next round tests books and broad order.

questions.prompt: Which person is named as the mother of Jesus?
questions.explanation: Mary is named as the mother of Jesus.

questions.prompt: Which place is widely linked with where Jesus grew up?
questions.explanation: Nazareth is widely linked with Jesus' early life.

questions.prompt: Which person is most linked with wisdom and many sayings?
questions.explanation: Solomon is strongly linked with wisdom.

questions.prompt: Which place is linked with Moses receiving commandments?
questions.explanation: Mount Sinai is linked with Moses and the commandments.

questions.prompt: Which place is most linked with a lake and many stories about Jesus?
questions.explanation: Galilee is linked with a lake and many stories about Jesus.

questions.prompt: Which person was one of Jesus' disciples and is often linked with fishing?
questions.explanation: Peter was a disciple and is linked with fishing.

questions.prompt: Which story is linked with Moses and the Red Sea?
choices: The visit of the wise men
questions.explanation: Moses and the Red Sea are linked with the crossing story.

questions.prompt: Which came later: the Exodus or Jesus teaching in Galilee?
choices: They happen at the same time
questions.explanation: Jesus teaching in Galilee appears much later than the Exodus.

stageGroups.title: Books And Order
stageGroups.encouragement: You are into the middle rounds. Next come parables and teachings.

questions.prompt: Which book is in the New Testament?
questions.explanation: Matthew is a New Testament book.

questions.prompt: Which came first in Bible order? Genesis or Acts.
questions.explanation: Genesis comes before Acts in Bible order.

questions.prompt: Which book comes at the beginning of the Bible?
questions.explanation: Genesis is the first book of the Bible.

questions.prompt: Which belongs earlier in the Bible story? Moses receiving commandments or Paul's letters.
choices: Both are in the same scene
questions.explanation: Moses appears far earlier than Paul's letters.

questions.prompt: Which item is not a Bible book?
questions.explanation: Banana is not a Bible book.

questions.prompt: Which book is widely known for songs and prayers?
questions.explanation: Psalms is widely known for songs and prayers.

questions.prompt: Which came later: the creation story or the kingdom of Israel?
questions.explanation: The kingdom of Israel appears later than the creation story.

questions.prompt: A clue says a book includes many wise sayings. Which answer is safest?
choices: The clue proves it is the last book
The clue proves it is a place
questions.explanation: Proverbs is widely linked with wise sayings.

stageGroups.title: Parables And Teachings
stageGroups.encouragement: Good focus. The next round follows the wider Bible journey.

questions.prompt: Which parable is about helping a traveler in need?
questions.explanation: The Good Samaritan is about helping a traveler in need.

questions.prompt: Which parable includes a son who returns home?
questions.explanation: The Prodigal Son includes a son returning home.

questions.prompt: Which teaching is closest to treating others as you want to be treated?
choices: Show others the care you would want
questions.explanation: This matches a broad Bible teaching about care for others.

questions.prompt: Which parable uses seeds and different kinds of ground?
questions.explanation: The parable of the sower uses seeds and ground.

questions.prompt: Which story is linked with Jesus feeding a large crowd?
questions.explanation: The feeding story is linked with loaves and fish.

questions.prompt: Which teaching phrase is widely known from the Bible?
questions.explanation: Love your neighbor is a widely known Bible teaching.

questions.prompt: Which parable is about one missing animal being found?
questions.explanation: The lost sheep is about one missing sheep being found.

questions.prompt: Which came first: Moses receiving commandments or Jesus telling parables?
questions.explanation: Moses receiving commandments appears earlier.

stageGroups.title: Journey Through The Bible
stageGroups.encouragement: The timeline is getting harder. Keep checking the order.

questions.prompt: Which came first: Abraham's journey or Daniel in Babylon?
questions.explanation: Abraham appears earlier than Daniel.

questions.prompt: Which story is linked with Abraham and Sarah having Isaac?
questions.explanation: Isaac is linked with the promise to Abraham and Sarah.

questions.prompt: Which happened before David became king?
questions.explanation: The Exodus appears before David's time.

questions.prompt: Which place is most linked with the Exodus story?
questions.explanation: Egypt is central to the Exodus story.

questions.prompt: Which person is strongly linked with Jericho after Moses?
questions.explanation: Joshua is linked with the story of Jericho.

questions.prompt: Which came later: prophets like Isaiah or Noah's ark?
choices: They happen in the same chapter
questions.explanation: The prophets appear later than Noah.

questions.prompt: Which story is linked with Jesus calming wind and water?
questions.explanation: Jesus calming wind and water is the calming the storm story.

questions.prompt: Which belongs closer to the end of the New Testament? Paul's letters or Genesis creation.
choices: Genesis is in the New Testament
questions.explanation: Paul's letters are in the New Testament; Genesis is at the beginning.

stageGroups.title: Careful Bible Clues
stageGroups.encouragement: Careful reading is paying off. Next is the timeline challenge.

questions.prompt: A clue says a traveler was helped by a stranger on the road. Which answer is safest?
choices: It points to the Good Samaritan story
It proves the traveler was Moses
It proves the road was in Egypt
questions.explanation: The clue safely points to the Good Samaritan story, not extra details.

questions.prompt: Which name appears twice: Moses, David, Moses, Peter?
questions.explanation: Moses appears twice in the list.

questions.prompt: Which story is linked with Daniel interpreting dreams?
questions.explanation: Daniel is linked with interpreting dreams in Babylon.

questions.prompt: Which choice best matches a broad Bible teaching about honesty?
questions.explanation: Telling the truth matches a broad Bible teaching.

questions.prompt: Which place is linked with the birth of Jesus?
questions.explanation: Bethlehem is linked with the birth of Jesus.

questions.prompt: A clue says a man spent time in a great fish and later went to Nineveh. Which answer is safest?
choices: The clue proves Nineveh is a river
The clue proves the story is a parable
questions.explanation: The safe conclusion is Jonah; the other details are not supported.

questions.prompt: The full list is Noah, Moses, David, Daniel. The shorter list is Noah, Moses, David. Which name is missing?
questions.explanation: Daniel is missing from the shorter list.

questions.prompt: Which story is most linked with walls falling at Jericho?
questions.explanation: Joshua and Jericho are linked with the walls of Jericho.

stageGroups.title: Timeline Challenge
stageGroups.encouragement: Final stretch. The last rounds mix everything together.

questions.prompt: Earlier, which place was paired with Birthplace?
questions.explanation: The earlier memory pair was Bethlehem = Birthplace.

questions.prompt: Which came first: Noah or Moses?
questions.explanation: Noah appears earlier than Moses.

questions.prompt: Which came later: David or Abraham?
questions.explanation: David appears later than Abraham.

questions.prompt: Which happened before Jesus' birth?
questions.explanation: The exile in Babylon happened before Jesus' birth.

questions.prompt: Which story is linked with the empty tomb?
questions.explanation: The empty tomb is linked with the resurrection of Jesus.

questions.prompt: Which person wrote letters to early Christian communities?
questions.explanation: Paul is known for letters to early Christian communities.

questions.prompt: Which belongs earlier in the Bible story? Jericho's walls or Daniel in Babylon.
questions.explanation: The Jericho story appears earlier than Daniel in Babylon.

questions.prompt: Which came later: Jesus telling parables or Moses at Sinai?
questions.explanation: Jesus telling parables comes later than Moses at Sinai.

stageGroups.title: Mixed Bible Knowledge
stageGroups.encouragement: One round left. The final challenge mixes memory, people, stories, and order.

questions.prompt: Which story is most linked with David facing Goliath?
questions.explanation: David and Goliath is one of the most recognized Bible stories.

questions.prompt: In the Good Samaritan parable, who helps the traveler?
questions.explanation: The helper in the parable is a Samaritan.

questions.prompt: Which teaching is linked with Moses and Mount Sinai?
questions.explanation: Moses and Mount Sinai are linked with the commandments.

questions.prompt: Which place is widely linked with the temple in the Bible?
questions.explanation: Jerusalem is widely linked with the temple.

questions.prompt: Which story is linked with a rainbow after the flood?
questions.explanation: The rainbow is linked with Noah's story after the flood.

questions.prompt: Which parable includes a father welcoming a returning son?
questions.explanation: The Prodigal Son includes a father welcoming his son back.

questions.prompt: Which action best matches a teaching about mercy?
choices: Showing kindness to someone in need
questions.explanation: Showing kindness is a simple example of mercy.

questions.prompt: Which pair matches exactly?
questions.explanation: Jericho - Walls is the exact matching pair.

questions.prompt: Which came first: creation or the Exodus?
questions.explanation: Creation appears before the Exodus.

questions.prompt: Which person is linked with leading people through the wilderness?
questions.explanation: Moses is linked with the wilderness journey.

questions.prompt: Which story includes Jesus being born in Bethlehem?
questions.explanation: Bethlehem is linked with the birth of Jesus.

questions.prompt: Earlier, which word was paired with Jericho?
questions.explanation: The earlier memory pair was Jericho = Walls.

questions.prompt: Which parable is about a lost sheep being found?
questions.explanation: The lost sheep is about a missing sheep being found.

questions.prompt: Which person is linked with preparing people for Jesus?
questions.explanation: John the Baptist is linked with preparing people for Jesus.

questions.prompt: Which story includes Jesus calming a storm?
questions.explanation: Jesus calming a storm is a widely known Gospel story.

questions.prompt: Which teaching is central to many teachings of Jesus?
choices: Love God and love your neighbor
questions.explanation: Love God and love your neighbor is a central Bible teaching.
